{
  "name": "superposition-embeddable-ui",
  "version": "0.1.9",
  "description": "Embeddable React UI for Superposition",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/juspay/superposition-embeddable-ui.git"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "react",
    "embeddable",
    "ui",
    "admin",
    "configuration",
    "superposition"
  ],
  "type": "module",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.js",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18.0.0"
  },
  "sideEffects": [
    "./src/blend-react-compat.ts",
    "**/*.css"
  ],
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/index.js"
    },
    "./admin": {
      "types": "./dist/admin.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/admin.js",
      "require": "./dist/admin.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/admin.js"
    },
    "./config-manager": {
      "types": "./dist/config-manager.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/config-manager.js",
      "require": "./dist/config-manager.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/config-manager.js"
    },
    "./dimension-manager": {
      "types": "./dist/dimension-manager.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/dimension-manager.js",
      "require": "./dist/dimension-manager.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/dimension-manager.js"
    },
    "./audit-trail": {
      "types": "./dist/audit-trail.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/audit-trail.js",
      "require": "./dist/audit-trail.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/audit-trail.js"
    },
    "./override-manager": {
      "types": "./dist/override-manager.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/override-manager.js",
      "require": "./dist/override-manager.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/override-manager.js"
    },
    "./experiment-manager": {
      "types": "./dist/experiment-manager.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/experiment-manager.js",
      "require": "./dist/experiment-manager.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/experiment-manager.js"
    },
    "./browser": {
      "types": "./dist/browser.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/browser.js",
      "require": "./dist/browser.cjs",
      "default": "./dist/browser.js"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./styles.css": "./dist/styles.css"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "CHANGELOG.md",
    "LICENSE"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "clean": "node ./scripts/clean-dist.mjs",
    "build:types": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly",
    "build:package": "vite build",
    "build:browser": "vite build --config vite.browser.config.ts",
    "build:browser:local-react-assets": "node ./scripts/copy-react-assets.mjs",
    "build:browser:shared-core": "vite build --config vite.cdn.core.external.config.ts",
    "build:browser:all-in-one-global": "vite build --config vite.cdn.external.config.ts",
    "build:browser:feature-globals": "node ./scripts/build-feature-globals.mjs",
    "build": "npm run clean && npm run build:types && npm run build:package && npm run build:browser && npm run build:browser:local-react-assets && npm run build:browser:shared-core && npm run build:browser:all-in-one-global && npm run build:browser:feature-globals && npm run validate:global-bundles",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage",
    "lint": "eslint src/ __tests__/",
    "format": "prettier --write 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx}' '__tests__/**/*.{ts,tsx}'",
    "format:check": "prettier --check 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx}' '__tests__/**/*.{ts,tsx}'",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "validate:react-compat": "node ./scripts/validate-react-compat.mjs",
    "validate:global-bundles": "node ./scripts/validate-global-bundles.mjs",
    "release": "node ./scripts/release.mjs",
    "demo": "vite dev --config demo/vite.config.ts --open demo/index.html",
    "demo:shared-core": "npm run build && vite dev --config demo/vite.config.ts --open demo/shared-core-feature-globals.html"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "react": "^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@testing-library/jest-dom": "^6.6.3",
    "@testing-library/react": "^16.1.0",
    "@testing-library/user-event": "^14.5.2",
    "@types/react": "^18.3.12",
    "@types/react-dom": "^18.3.1",
    "@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin": "^8.16.0",
    "@typescript-eslint/parser": "^8.16.0",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^6.0.3",
    "eslint": "^9.15.0",
    "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "^5.0.0",
    "jsdom": "^25.0.1",
    "prettier": "^3.4.2",
    "react": "^18.3.1",
    "react-dom": "^18.3.1",
    "typescript": "^5.7.2",
    "vite": "^8.1.3",
    "vite-plugin-dts": "^4.3.0",
    "vitest": "^4.1.9"
  },
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "dependencies": {
    "@juspay/blend-design-system": "^0.0.36",
    "lucide-react": "^0.511.0",
    "superposition-sdk": "^0.113.0"
  }
}
